from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information about one paper in the collection, focusing on its citation relationships to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers found in this paper's bibliography. Must match the exact titles from the document summaries.")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
